items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Hampton Hawes... was coming out of high school just about the time that Sonny was coming out of school. So we all would play on Sundays out there.

ctx.x: No. I think... Wait a minute, now. Might have been! Because Hamp didn't get out of high school really until '46, I think. Sonny came out in '45. I think Hamp came out in '46. Might have been. I didn't play with that band, but I used to be in there all the time, you know.
And there was another place called Glenn's, just about 35th and Western, a place that used to serve barbecue...
